notes: Initial cache attempt failed because the shallow ProofWidgets checkout lacked its release tag; fetching exact tag v0.0.74 resolved that.
Parallel cache requests encountered HTTP 429. Successful files were retained and the tail downloaded at a low sequential rate, with complete public URL/response/hash records.
A deliberately interrupted urllib downloader was replaced by a persistent session to reduce HTTPS connection overhead.

The initial persistent-client initialization required explicit use of the existing HTTPS_PROXY because the HTTP client could not load its optional SOCKS dependency. Standard proxy and TLS certificate verification remained enabled.
